c74object.name: bachmcp.algorithm
c74object.digest: An algorithm instance of any type
c74object.description: One instance the model writes algorithms for: a generator (function produce(p): music from nothing), a transformer (function transform(source, p): changes the score it receives), a selector (function select(source, p): picks notes of the score it receives, which go back to the roll as its selection). The second argument fixes the type. It runs bachmcp.runner.js in a v8, and scores come in and go out as dictionaries (bachjson-complete): put a bachmcp.translate on each side to talk to a bach.roll, and connect its panel outlet to a bachmcp.gui.params and back. bachmcp.bpatcher.algorithm does all that wiring. It talks to the bachmcp.server open in any patch, and finds its algorithms in <playground>/algorithms/. Messages for the roll (dump, clearselection, sel, add..., clearmarkers) are ignored at the inlet, so instances can be chained.

inlet.digest: prompt, param, bang, dictionary, load_algo, capture, open, name ...

outlet.digest: To bach.roll: dump, clearselection, sel note ..., markers
bang when a process is done (after its score)
Dumpout: algo_loaded, algo_done, algo_error, error, processing, specs, name, type

objarg.name: name
objarg.description: The name the model and the server know this instance by. Unique across open patches.

objarg.name: type
objarg.description: What the instance is, and which algorithms it loads. It cannot change afterwards.

method.name: prompt
method.description: Sends the text to this instance's conversation, after its skills and profile. The model, local or Claude (whichever bachmcp.server runs), answers by writing for this instance, and what it writes loads by itself. Connect a bachmcp.prompt to send it.

method.name: open
method.description: Opens the loaded algorithm's code in an editor.

method.name: name
method.description: Gives the instance a new name: the server and the model know it by this one from now on. One word.

method.name: get_name
method.description: Sends name <name> out of the dumpout outlet.

method.name: get_type
method.description: Sends type <type> out of the dumpout outlet.

method.name: set_as_active_instance
method.description: Makes this the active instance: the one a Claude written to directly (Claude Desktop or Claude Code) works for.

method.name: remove
method.description: The server forgets everything it holds for this instance: its answer (stopped), its prompts waiting, its conversation and its own skills. Files stay: prompts/<name>.jsonl is read again if it is prompted later.

method.name: bang
method.description: Outputs the score of the current settings: the last one again if nothing changed since, otherwise a new run. A load is not a run: nothing goes out until a bang (or a parameter change with auto_dump 1).

method.name: run
method.description: Runs the algorithm now, changed or not.

method.name: repeat
method.description: Sends the last score (and a selector's commands to the roll) again.

method.name: param
method.description: Sets a parameter of the algorithm, e.g. param times 32 or param register 4800 8400. Pitch parameters also take note names (param root Db4). Parameters come in only this way, so any name is free for them; a bare times 32 is refused.

method.name: load
method.description: Loads a file. A load is not a run: it says algo_loaded out of the dumpout outlet and nothing else goes out until a bang.

method.name: load_algo
method.description: The same as load; a failure says error: impossible to load .... This is what the model's send_algorithm sends.

method.name: try_load_algo
method.description: The same as load, but a file that cannot be loaded is ignored without an error.

method.name: reload
method.description: Reads the algorithm file again. It also happens by itself when the file changes (see watch).

method.name: get_specs
method.digest: Send the parameters to the panel
method.description: Sends the loaded algorithm's parameters to the panel again, with their current values. Answers specs 1 (sent) or specs 0 (no algorithm loaded) out of the dumpout outlet.

method.name: auto_dump
method.description: 1 (default): a parameter change outputs a score. 0: only bang does.

method.name: snap
method.description: 0 semitones, 1 quarter tones, 3 free (default).

method.name: bypass
method.description: 1: runs do nothing, and a score at the inlet goes straight out. 0 (default): the algorithm runs.

method.name: write_to_playground
method.description: Writes the last score sent to <playground>/scores/<name>.json.

method.name: verbose
method.description: 1: says in the Max console what happens. Default 0: only errors.

method.name: watch
method.description: 1 (default): reloads the file when it changes on disk.

method.name: sync
method.digest: Apply the panel's values without running
method.description: What the panel sends after a load: sync param ..., sync snap ..., sync bypass ..., sync source_mode ..., sync process_only_selection ..., sync dump_selection_only .... Applied without a run.

method.name: dictionary
method.description: A score as a dictionary (bachjson-complete). A transformer and a selector take it as their source, according to source_mode; it never runs the algorithm by itself, so there is no loop through a roll. A generator only passes it through while bypassed.

method.name: source_mode
method.description: 1 (default): only the first run asks for a score, which is held as the source; every later run starts again from it. 0: every run asks the roll for its score, so it works on what the roll holds now. Only a transformer or a selector takes it.

method.name: process_only_selection
method.description: 1: only the selected notes (bach's flag 16, which a selector sets), and the other notes are put back as they were. 0 (default): the whole score. Only a transformer or a selector takes it.

method.name: input_mode
method.description: The same as process_only_selection, kept for old patches. Only a transformer or a selector takes it.

method.name: capture
method.description: Asks the roll for its score (dump): the next score in becomes the source, in either source_mode. Only a transformer or a selector takes it.

method.name: input
method.description: input clear: forgets the source; the next run asks for a new one. Only a transformer or a selector takes it.

method.name: dump_selection_only
method.description: 1 (default): only the selected notes. 0: the whole source, the selected notes flagged. Only a selector takes it.

method.name: dump_selection
method.description: Sends the selected notes as a score, out of the score outlet. Only a selector takes it.

method.name: clear_selection
method.description: Nothing stays selected: sends the score, then clearselection to the roll. Only a selector takes it.

method.name: involutive
method.description: Ignored for now: every run replaces the previous selection. Only a selector takes it.

attribute.name: source_mode
attribute.description: Transformer and selector: see the source_mode message.

attribute.name: auto_dump
attribute.description: 1: a parameter change outputs a score. 0: only bang does.

attribute.name: input_mode
attribute.description: Transformer and selector: the same as the process_only_selection message, as an attribute.

attribute.name: skills
attribute.description: global (default): the skills the bachmcp.server chose (its skills). Otherwise the names of skill files in playground/skills/ (without .md), read after the profile's: this instance then reads only what it chose. Applied at the next prompt.

attribute.name: profile
attribute.description: global (default): the server's profile (its profile). Otherwise a file in playground/skills/profiles/ (without .json), e.g. minimal-algorithmic-composer or minimal-electronic-composer. Applied at the next prompt.
